title: JWST just made the "Crisis in Cosmology" WORSE
summary: Astrophysicist Dr. Becky explains the Hubble tension, the disagreement between expansion-rate measurements from the cosmic microwave background and the distance ladder, and what early JWST Cepheid observations add.
why: Recommended as an accessible layperson introduction to the Hubble tension when new expansion-rate results make the news.

quote.text: she introduces laymen to the problems well
